messages:
josh_releases: Quick heads-up — PR #5289 (kv cache hard crash under tail latencies) is queued for tonight's hotfix. We need 2x approvals before the 18:30 PT cutover. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5289
anna_eng: On it, can take a pass in ~10m :eyes:
priya_prod: I can do a prod-risk pass and smoke plan review. ping me if you want me to run canary checks.
tim_oncall: Available to run the canary 18:20-19:00 PT. If you want pairing for the final review I can join.
josh_releases: TL;DR of change: avoids null eviction path in kv_cache_manager.py; mostly a safety check but affects hot path. Tests: unit + integ added. Small diff snippet: ```diff
- if (entry->candidate == NULL) { /* noop */ }
+ if (!entry || entry->candidate == NULL) { /* fall back to eviction-safe path */ }
```
priya_prod: Nice. Can you add a one-line migration note to the PR description about potential extra evictions for 1 deploy-window? helps SRE triage.
josh_releases: added note and smoke checklist: ```- deploy to canary (5%)
- run kv-warmup job x3
- monitor tail latency + OOMs for 15m
- rollback plan: revert commit + scale-down canary```
deploy-bot: Reminder — cutover window opens 18:30 PT. Automated merge gate will block merges without 2 approvals at 18:15 PT.
anna_eng: LGTM — left one tiny comment about a log message (non-blocking). :white_check_mark:
priya_prod: Second LGTM. I'll keep an eye on canary and metrics during the window. :thumbsup:
josh_releases: Thanks both — merging in ~5 unless anything else pops up. Will post canary updates in #incidents if anything noisy shows. :rocket:
